description_en: Returns the account information of distributor customers
description_zh: 返回分销客户账号信息
name: GetAccountInfo

parameters.help_en: The UID of the distributor customer account. Either this parameter or the UserType parameter is required. If this parameter is left empty, all distributor customer accounts of the specified UserType are queried
parameters.help_zh: 分销客户账号UID，此参数和UserType参数必须有一个。如果此参数为空，则查询UserType类型的所有分销客户账号
parameters.name: uid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the distributor customer account. Valid values:
1: End User
2: enterprise customer 
3: T2 partner
parameters.help_zh:
分销客户账号类型，取值范围:
1 End User
2 企业客户 
3 T2伙伴
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 20
parameters.name: page_size

AccountNickname.description_en: The nickname of the distributor customer account. For enterprise customers, this is the company name. For T2 partners, this is the partner name
AccountNickname.description_zh: 分销客户账户昵称。 对于企业客户，是公司名称。 对于T2伙伴，则是伙伴名称

AliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud logon name of the distributor customer account
AliyunId.description_zh: 分销客户账户阿里云登录名

AssociationSuccessTime.description_en: The time when the distributor customer account was associated with the partner account to establish the distributor relationship
AssociationSuccessTime.description_zh: 分销客户账户与伙伴账户建立分销主子关系的关联时间

Cid.description_en: The CID of the distributor customer

CustomerAccountType.description_en:
The account type of the customer. Valid values:
0: individual
1: enterprise
CustomerAccountType.description_zh: 客户的账号类型，0个人，1企业
CustomerAccountType.title_zh: 客户的账号类型，0个人，1企业

CustomerBd.description_en: The business development manager of the customer

CustomerEnterpriseCertified.description_en:
Indicates whether the customer has completed enterprise real-name verification. Valid values:
0: no
1: yes
CustomerEnterpriseCertified.description_zh: 客户是否企业实名，0否，1是
CustomerEnterpriseCertified.title_zh: 客户是否企业实名，0 否，1是

DelayAmount.description_en: The overdraft quota when the suspension policy is set to delayStop (delayed suspension)
DelayAmount.description_zh: 当延停策略为delayStop（延迟停机）时，透支的额度
DelayAmount.title_zh: 当延停策略为delayStop（延迟停机）时，透支的额度

DelayStatus.description_en:
The suspension policy. Valid values:
immediatelyStop: immediately suspends the account.
delayStop: suspends the account after a delay. The overdraft quota is specified by the DelayAmount field.
noStop: does not suspend the account
DelayStatus.description_zh:
延停策略。取值三个如下
1、immediatelyStop，立即停机
2、delayStop，延迟停机。延迟停机额度见delayAmount字段
3、noStop，不停机
DelayStatus.title_zh:
延停策略。取值三个如下
1、immediatelyStop，立即停机
2、delayStop，延迟停机。延迟停机额度见delayAmount字段
3、noStop，不停机

Email.description_en: The email address of the distributor customer account
Email.description_zh: 分销客户账户电子邮件地址

Mobile.description_en: The mobile phone number of the distributor customer account

NewBuyStatus.description_en:
The purchase status. Valid values:
Purchase Forbidden: purchasing is prohibited.
Normal: purchasing is allowed
NewBuyStatus.description_zh:
下单状态，取值如下
Purchase Forbidden（禁止下单）
Normal（正常）

RegisterCountryCode.description_en: The country code of the customer registration country/region

Remark.description_en: The description of the distributor customer account

SubAccountType.description_en:
The account type. Valid values:
1: end customer of Agency
2: end customer of Reseller
3: enterprise customer
4: Agency-type T2 partner
5: Reseller-type T2 partner
6: Agency+Reseller-type T2 partner
SubAccountType.description_zh:
账户类型:
1 Agency的终端客户
2 Reseller的终端客户
3 企业客户
4 Agency类型2级伙伴
5 Reseller类型2级伙伴
6 Agency+Reseller类型2级伙伴

Uid.description_en: The UID of the distributor customer account

Code.description_en:
The result code. Valid values:
200: OK
1109: System Error
3029: Invalid UID
3062: Uid and UserType are both empty
3063: UserType value out of range
Code.description_zh:
结果码
Error Code. Value Range: 
200: OK 
1109: System Error 
3029: Invalid UID 
3062: Uid and UserType are both empty 
3063: UserType value out of range

Page.description_en: The page number of the current page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求id，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the current API call is successful. Valid values: True and False. This does not indicate whether subsequent business operations are successful
Success.description_zh: 候选值:True/False，代表了是否当前API调用本身是成功 的。不代表后续业务操作的成功
